sections.title: Bank and private-label card personalisation

children.text: At Monétique Tunisie, we believe every card can be as unique as its holder. That is why we offer a card personalisation service covering both graphic and technical aspects. Using state-of-the-art personalisation equipment, we personalise the magnetic stripe, the chip (contact and contactless) and the design of the card body, including the image. With advanced techniques such as laser engraving, indent printing and embossing, we enable our clients to turn their bank cards into personal, secure works of art that reflect their identity and preferences.

sections.title: PIN change

children.text: At Monétique Tunisie, we understand how important personalised security is for cardholders. That is why we offer a PIN change service, allowing users to change the personal PIN associated with their card. This feature strengthens security by letting cardholders choose a code that is easy for them to remember as well as personal and secure. The option is available through a range of channels, including ATMs, online banking and other customer service channels, for a smooth and secure user experience.

sections.title: PIN unblock

children.text: Aware of the challenges posed by international transactions, Monétique Tunisie offers acquiring institutions an access fee recovery service. It is designed to offset the costs generated by these transactions, ensuring efficient and fair management of cross-border operations. With this system, we make fee recovery transparent for our partners, delivering an optimised financial experience for all parties involved.

sections.title: Access fees

children.text: Aware of the challenges posed by international transactions, Monétique Tunisie offers acquiring institutions an access fee recovery service. It is designed to offset the costs generated by these transactions, ensuring efficient and fair management of cross-border operations. With this system, we make fee recovery transparent for our partners, delivering an optimised financial experience for all parties involved.

sections.title: Facilitating and authorising financial transactions

children.text: The payment switch is a cornerstone of the payments ecosystem, playing a crucial role in facilitating and authorising financial transactions in real time. As the national switch, Monétique Tunisie provides a central interface for payment processing, building a direct and secure communication bridge between financial institutions. This enables us to offer exceptional fluidity, enhanced security and unrivalled efficiency in processing our clients' transactions.

sections.title: Instant verification of financial transactions

children.text: When a cardholder initiates a transaction, our payment switch immediately checks the validity of the card, the availability of funds and compliance with the required security parameters. This instant verification is essential not only for the rapid authorisation of the transaction but also for maintaining an optimal level of security, protecting the financial interests of cardholders and banks.

sections.title: Smooth and secure banking transactions

children.text: As a payment switch, our commitment is to ensure that every transaction is processed with the utmost care, providing a smooth and secure user experience. By seamlessly connecting banks and other financial institutions, Monétique Tunisie plays an indispensable role in the payments ecosystem, contributing to the confidence and stability of the Tunisian financial market.

seo.metaDescription: Facilitating and authorising financial transactions

solutions.tagline: Mobile payment, the solution for all your spontaneous purchases
solutions.summary: Mobile payment, the solution for all your spontaneous purchases

sections.title: Mobile payment, the solution for all your spontaneous purchases

children.text: Monétique Tunisie's mobile switch is a major innovation in digital payments, offering an integrated technology platform that supports a range of essential features for managing mobile financial transactions. This advanced solution handles authorisation, payment, money transfers and cash-in and cash-out operations, all within a secure environment through electronic wallets.

sections.title: A secure and smooth user experience

children.text: As a central intermediary, our mobile switch ensures smooth and efficient communication between all parties in the payment process: users, merchants, banks and payment institutions. Thanks to this infrastructure, users can make payments, transfer money, and top up or carry out cash-in/cash-out operations with their wallet, for a secure and frictionless experience.

sections.title: Transforming the digital payments landscape

children.text: The mobile switch plays an undeniable role in modernising financial services. It improves connectivity within the mobile payments ecosystem, strengthens transaction security and broadens access to financial services for more users. This innovative approach underpins our commitment to financial inclusion and to transforming the digital payments landscape.

seo.metaDescription: Mobile payment, the solution for all your spontaneous purchases

sections.title: Paysmart, the bill payment aggregation platform

children.text: Paysmart is a significant step forward in payments, placing Monétique Tunisie at the forefront of financial innovation. This bill payment aggregation platform is designed to facilitate and boost interactions between payment service providers (PSPs) and billers. It offers twofold value: billers can present their bills efficiently to many PSPs, while customers enjoy unrivalled flexibility in paying their bills by various means, including bank cards, wallets and bank transfers.

sections.title: More connected, flexible and accessible finance

children.text: The launch of Paysmart reflects Monétique Tunisie's ongoing commitment to simplifying and securing financial transactions for everyone involved. This innovative solution improves the payment experience for end customers and also streamlines bill management for billers, giving them broad visibility with PSPs. In short, Paysmart embodies our vision of more connected, flexible and accessible finance, in step with the market's changing needs.

sections.title: Digital transformation of the financial sector

children.text: With Paysmart, Monétique Tunisie strengthens its role as a catalyst for the digital transformation of the financial sector, making it easy to integrate payments into the daily lives of consumers and businesses. This initiative reflects our ambition to keep innovating and to offer solutions that anticipate and meet the challenges of the modern financial world.

sections.title: A leader in financial equipment

children.text: Monétique Tunisie is a leading reference in the certification of financial equipment. Our expertise covers a wide range of equipment and solutions, including automated teller machines (ATMs), payment terminals (POS), innovative technologies such as Tap to Phone and SoftPOS, payment facilitator (PayFac) services and customised private-label solutions.

sections.title: Full compliance and reliability of financial devices

children.text: Our certification process is rigorously designed to meet the strictest security standards and current international regulations, ensuring the full compliance and reliability of financial devices. This commitment to quality and security covers every step required for approval, guaranteeing the legitimacy and effectiveness of the payment systems deployed.

sections.title: A strategic partner for financial institutions and businesses

children.text: With close attention to detail and a constant pursuit of excellence, Monétique Tunisie is the ideal strategic partner for financial institutions and businesses seeking secure, reliable payment solutions that comply with international standards. Our role in ensuring the compliance of financial equipment highlights our essential contribution to the financial ecosystem, facilitating the adoption of advanced and secure payment technologies.

seo.metaDescription: A leader in financial equipment

sections.title: Security of bank card transactions

children.text: Monétique Tunisie is a key player in securing bank card transactions. Relying on cutting-edge technologies, the company actively monitors and manages fraud risks, strengthening user confidence in the financial ecosystem.

sections.title: Committed to protecting financial operations

children.text: As a pillar of trust and security, Monétique Tunisie embodies a commitment to protecting financial operations through an advanced fraud monitoring solution. This proactive approach to detecting and preventing fraud demonstrates an ongoing commitment to innovating and improving systems to anticipate emerging threats.

sections.title: A secure and reliable transaction experience

children.text: Monétique Tunisie thus strengthens its leadership by guaranteeing a secure and reliable transaction experience, while underlining its lasting dedication to the integrity and security of financial transactions.

seo.metaDescription: Security of bank card transactions

solutions.name: Hosting of servers and technology solutions

sections.title: Secure hosting and technology solutions

children.text: Aware of how critical security is in electronic payment services, Monétique Tunisie is firmly committed to providing secure hosting for its partners' servers and technology solutions. Putting security first is driven by the need to protect our clients' sensitive data against any form of vulnerability.

sections.title: Data confidentiality, integrity and availability

children.text: Our hosting infrastructure is designed to provide the highest level of security, with advanced technologies and rigorous protection measures. The environments hosting our partners' servers benefit from next-generation firewalls, sophisticated intrusion detection systems and strong encryption protocols, ensuring data confidentiality, integrity and availability.

sections.title: Compliance with the strictest international standards

children.text: Our security excellence is not just a matter of internal commitment: it is validated by regular inspections carried out by renowned international institutions such as VISA and Mastercard. These rigorous audits confirm our ability to maintain first-class physical and operational security. Our PCI DSS certification, renewed every year, also demonstrates our ongoing compliance with the strictest international standards for payment card data security.

sections.title: A solid and reliable infrastructure to protect digital assets

children.text: At Monétique Tunisie, secure hosting is more than a service: it is a promise of peace of mind for our partners and their customers. By adopting and maintaining some of the highest information security standards in the industry, we provide a solid and reliable infrastructure to protect the digital assets that are essential in today's financial landscape.

seo.metaDescription: Secure hosting and technology solutions

sections.title: The undisputed leader in electronic payments

children.text: Monétique Tunisie is proud to be the undisputed leader in electronic payments, offering a comprehensive range of technical support services designed to meet our clients' varied needs. As a certified external training centre, our commitment to excellence is reflected in tailored training programmes. These programmes are carefully designed to build the essential skills of electronic payment professionals, supporting their success and growth in a constantly changing environment.

sections.title: We optimise our clients' payment infrastructure and operational performance

children.text: Beyond training, Monétique Tunisie is a trusted adviser, offering strategic and technical consulting services. Our aim is to help clients select the solutions best suited to their specific needs, with expert advice reflecting industry best practices and the latest technological innovations. This consultative approach enables us to guide our partners towards informed decisions, optimising their payment infrastructure and operational performance.

sections.title: We guarantee compliance and client satisfaction

children.text: In chargeback management, Monétique Tunisie offers banks a highly efficient dispute management service. We ensure that the chargeback process is handled with the utmost precision and transparency, minimising inconvenience for banks and their customers while guaranteeing compliance and satisfaction.

faqs.question: What can I do with a bank card?

children.text: Withdraw cash easily:
access your money 24/7 at all automated teller machines (ATMs) with your card.
Secure payments everywhere:
pay for your purchases at thousands of merchants, in store or online, safely and simply.
Here is what to do:
Block your card immediately:
block your card without delay to prevent fraudulent transactions by contacting your bank and calling the Call Centre, available 24/7, on (+216) 71 155 840.
Confirm in writing:
send a registered letter to your bank to confirm the block and support your request.
File a police report in case of theft:
file a complaint with the police. This may help you get the stolen amounts refunded.
Beware of errors:
if you enter a wrong PIN three times, your card will be blocked.
Solution:
contact your bank branch to retrieve your PIN.

faqs.question: Where can I get a bank card?

children.text: Your banker is your main point of contact for obtaining a bank card. They will help you choose the card best suited to your needs and explain in detail how it works.

A wallet, or electronic purse, is an app that lets you store and use your money electronically on your smartphone or any other connected device. Imagine swapping your bulky physical wallet for a convenient app. That is the promise of the wallet, which is changing the way you manage your everyday finances.

faqs.question: How do I get a wallet?

children.text: To start enjoying the benefits of a wallet, simply download your bank's or payment institution's electronic wallet app on your smartphone. Many banks and payment institutions offer their own apps, available on the App Store for iOS devices and on Google Play for Android devices. In a few simple steps, you can:
Choose a wallet app compatible with your device and your needs.
Download and install the app from the appropriate store.
Create an account and follow the instructions to set up your wallet.

faqs.question: What can I do with my cardholder wallet?

children.text: With a cardholder wallet, you can pay contactless with ease:
Make your purchases in the blink of an eye by holding your smartphone near the contactless payment terminal.
Enjoy a smooth and fast payment experience in your favourite shops.
View your balance and transaction history in real time.
And much more:
Manage your budgets and track your spending in real time.
Secure your data with cutting-edge technologies.

faqs.question: What can I do with my merchant wallet?

children.text: As a merchant, the wallet gives you a range of features to simplify the day-to-day management of your business and improve your customers' experience.
Accept contactless payments:
Collect your customers' payments easily.
Offer your customers a smooth and fast payment experience, reducing queues and increasing their satisfaction.
Benefit from a modern and secure payment solution suited to today's needs.
In addition to accepting payments, you can use the merchant wallet as a cardholder wallet.
Manage your transactions with ease:
View your transaction history and the details of each sale in real time.
Use reporting tools to analyse your sales and identify trends.
Export your transaction data to simplify your accounting.
Improve the security of your payments:
Benefit from cutting-edge technologies that protect your transactions against fraud and unauthorised payments.

Paysmart is Monétique Tunisie's bill payment aggregation platform. It allows billers to present their bills to many payment service providers (PSPs), and customers to pay their bills by various means of payment.

faqs.question: Which payment methods does Paysmart accept?

children.text: Bank cards, wallets and bank transfers.
Partner billers include STEG, SONEDE, Tunisie Telecom, Topnet and Tunisie Autoroutes.

The CVV2, or Card Verification Value 2, is a three-digit security code printed on the back of your payment card, usually in the signature area. It plays a crucial role in protecting your online and telephone transactions by verifying that you are the legitimate cardholder.

When you shop online, the merchant website will ask you to enter your card's CVV2 in addition to the usual details, such as the card number and expiry date. This extra code confirms that you have the physical card in your possession.

An OTP, or One-Time Password, is a password generated for a single session and requested when you pay on a merchant website. It is often sent by SMS and strengthens the security of online transactions by adding an extra layer of protection to your identity.

When you pay or shop online, you will be asked to enter an OTP in addition to the CVV2. This unique code, usually valid for only a few minutes, confirms that you are the holder of the bank card making the payment.

Phishing is a fraud technique in which cybercriminals send deceptive messages to trick recipients into disclosing sensitive personal information, such as bank card numbers, login credentials or passwords. These messages often appear to come from trusted sources.

faqs.question: How can I avoid having my card details stolen online?

children.text: Use secure websites (shown by "https" and a padlock in the address bar).
Never share your card details by email or SMS.
Turn on transaction notifications, where available, to monitor the operations made with your card in real time.
Use strong, unique passwords for each online account and turn on two-factor authentication (2FA) where possible.

faqs.question: How can I check that a website is secure?

children.text: Look for the padlock icon in the browser's address bar.
Make sure the web address starts with "https" (the "s" stands for secure).
Read the site's privacy policy and legal notice to check that it is legitimate.

cards.title: PIN Sender
cards.text: With PIN Sender, Monétique Tunisie offers a modern and secure alternative to traditional PIN mailing. This fully digital solution sends the confidential code (PIN) instantly by SMS as soon as the card is received. By eliminating paper and logistical constraints, it makes the service easier to access while reducing its environmental impact.

cards.eyebrow: Tap to Pay / Tap to Phone
cards.title: SoftPOS
cards.text: SoftPOS, also known as Tap to Pay or Tap to Phone, is a software-based solution that turns NFC-enabled Android smartphones and tablets into payment acceptance terminals. Unlike traditional POS terminals, it represents a significant step forward in electronic transactions.

bullets.text: A software alternative to traditional POS terminals

cards.title: PayFac
cards.text: A payment facilitator, also called a PayFac, is a service provider that enables merchants to process bank card payments quickly, efficiently and securely. It acts as an intermediary between its clients and financial institutions and offers a payment solution that integrates easily with existing platforms and management systems.

children.text: Founded in 1989 by the Tunisian banks and the national post office, Monétique Tunisie is a public limited company under Tunisian private law specialising in digital payment solutions in Tunisia. A pioneer in payment solutions, Monétique Tunisie is the national payment switch, mobile switch and bill aggregator.
Monétique Tunisie's mission is to deliver innovative, tailor-made digital payment solutions designed to meet our clients' exact requirements.

Our commitment is to provide a seamless and efficient user experience, backed by constant technology watch and first-class transaction security. We aim to be our clients' growth partners, offering them top-quality digital payment solutions and actively contributing to the development of the digital payments sector in Tunisia.

blocks.title: Supporting the growth of our partners and clients

children.text: Supporting the growth of our partners and clients by providing them with advanced, secure payment technologies tailored to their specific needs.

At Monétique Tunisie, we are determined to keep innovating and to strengthen the security of our infrastructure, ensuring reliable and efficient financial transactions for all economic players in Tunisia.

Monétique Tunisie was founded by the Tunisian banks and the national post office. A public limited company with share capital of TND 5,000,000, it is an interbank centre licensed by the Banque Centrale de Tunisie.
Monétique Tunisie has applied its electronic payment expertise to high-value projects in Tunisia, the Maghreb and Africa. It is a partner of 14 African banks.

blocks.title: The leader in payment systems in Tunisia

children.text: A major player in electronic and mobile payments, Monétique Tunisie stands out for its exceptional expertise, confirming its position as the market leader in Tunisia.

With a team of highly qualified professionals and long experience, Monétique Tunisie excels in the design, implementation and management of innovative payment solutions. As the national payment switch, its expertise ranges from digital payment services to transaction processing solutions and bank card personalisation, while guaranteeing the security of financial operations.

Monétique Tunisie also stands out for its ability to anticipate market developments and offer solutions tailored to its clients' specific needs, contributing to the modernisation and efficiency of payment systems in Tunisia.

keyPoints.text: Interbank centre licensed by the BCT

blocks.title: A pioneer of e-commerce in Tunisia

children.text: With exceptional expertise in e-commerce, Monétique Tunisie embodies excellence in the field, offering tailor-made solutions that meet the exact requirements of online businesses.
Our in-depth understanding of e-commerce challenges enables us to deploy efficient and secure digital payment services, simplifying online transactions for an optimal user experience.
As a trusted partner of financial institutions, Monétique Tunisie is determined to accelerate and secure e-commerce operations by onboarding businesses onto our secure payment platform, ClicToPay.
Our unwavering commitment and in-depth expertise make us a key player in supporting the growth and prosperity of e-commerce in Tunisia, contributing to dynamism and innovation in the sector.

keyPoints.text: Online payment secured by CVV2 and OTP

children.text: As the national mobile payment switch, Monétique Tunisie is a pillar in the development of digital financial transactions in Tunisia.

With our command of technological advances and our keen sense of market trends, we are the undisputed leader in payments in Tunisia. We offer intuitive mobile payment solutions with a strong focus on data confidentiality and security for flawless transactions.

A central player in the sector in Tunisia, Monétique Tunisie is at the heart of promoting mobile payment, playing a crucial role in transforming and modernising the Tunisian financial sector. Our active involvement is paving the way for a new era of digital finance marked by accessibility, security and innovation.

blocks.title: The benchmark for payment security in Tunisia

children.text: In financial transactions, Monétique Tunisie is the absolute benchmark for payment security, covering both traditional card payments and the innovative mobile payment sector. Our unwavering commitment to preserving the confidentiality and integrity of every transaction makes us a true guardian of financial security. With a proactive approach backed by continuous monitoring of emerging cybersecurity threats, we have developed cutting-edge security solutions designed to neutralise any potential vulnerability.

By implementing next-generation encryption protocols, integrating strong authentication mechanisms and deploying high-precision anti-fraud systems, our mission is to build a secure and tamper-proof transaction environment. This advanced expertise in payment security illustrates Monétique Tunisie's deep commitment to safeguarding its clients' financial interests and its pioneering role in protecting financial data within the Tunisian payments ecosystem.

blocks.title: Your strategic partner for consulting and training

children.text: With an expert and experienced team of highly qualified trainers, Monétique Tunisie is committed to sharing its in-depth know-how through rigorous, up-to-date training programmes.

Monétique Tunisie's certified external training centre is a valuable resource for industry professionals, offering specialised courses covering various aspects of electronic payments, digital payment and related technologies.

Alongside its commitment to training, Monétique Tunisie also excels in consulting, supporting its clients in their strategy. With an in-depth understanding of market developments and specific needs, it offers personalised consulting services aimed at optimising payment systems, integrating new technologies and strengthening the security of financial transactions.

This dual expertise in training and consulting makes Monétique Tunisie an essential strategic partner for payment industry players seeking to improve their skills, optimise their systems and actively contribute to their expansion and growth.

blocks.title: At the cutting edge of new technologies on the market

children.text: Improving the security of card payments is ongoing work. Preventing and combating fraud are permanent principles that lead Monétique-Tunisie to continually improve preventive security measures, whether for cards, terminals or remote payments.

Monétique Tunisie has highly developed electronic payment expertise, which it has applied to high-value projects in Tunisia. Today, Monétique Tunisie is ideally placed to offer fully integrated solutions that guarantee a high level of performance and complete security.

Monétique Tunisie constantly monitors developments in its areas of expertise. In recent years, accelerating technological change (MMS, Web 2.0, etc.) and new behaviours (the mobile boom, nomadic use, e-commerce, etc.) have created new needs for even more secure and intelligent means of payment.

blocks.title: A few security rules to follow

children.text: A bank card is one of the safest means of payment, provided you follow the security rules. You can pay by bank card in many shops or online. It is important to follow certain security advice, in particular to prevent fraudulent use of your card by a third party. Your bank card is personal: never give anyone your four-digit PIN, learn it by heart and avoid writing it down.
Security at ATMs
When withdrawing cash:
Don't let yourself be distracted.
Enter your PIN out of sight of others.
Refuse help from anyone.
If you cannot retrieve your bank card, block it immediately (some ATMs are tampered with).
Security online
Most people whose bank card number has been stolen have never ordered anything online. Here are some tips to secure your bank card payments online:
Favour well-known merchant sites and reputable brands.
Be wary of websites of foreign companies.
Identify the merchant's contact details. Read the general terms of sale (this information should be accessible from the home page, as a sign of transparency).
Pay on a secure page by checking that a closed padlock is displayed and that the website's URL begins with https:// (the "s" stands for secure).
Keep the confirmation email for your order.
Take screenshots or print the screen at each step of the order.
Check the amount of the payment on your bank statement.
Do not store your bank card number or its code on your computer.
Keep your computer's protection systems (antivirus) up to date.
Good to know:
although many internet users are reluctant to pay for their online purchases with their bank card, this system is highly secure thanks to encryption.
Security at merchants
Abroad is where your bank card is most at risk, so be even more vigilant. Here are some recommendations:
Check the amount shown on the screen carefully before entering your PIN.
Enter your PIN out of sight of others, using your hand as a shield.
Never let your bank card out of your sight.

Some businesses, particularly in tourism, have a dubious practice: they photocopy your bank card. Refuse this practice: an unscrupulous person could copy the back of your card, where your security code appears.

Monétique-Tunisie has an active risk manager on its team who provides online monitoring using tools that detect all operations with a potential risk of fraud and automatically trigger alerts and analyses on the cases detected.
